beats.text: Half of Niger is younger than 15, while half of Japan is older than 49.
Central African Republic is 14, the lowest of all 219.
Japan is 49. That is 3.5 times the Central African Republic.
China is 39. That is 2.6 times the age of Chad at 15.
USA is 38. That is 2.5 times Niger.
The oldest? Italy has 47, Portugal has 46, and Germany has 45.
